submitted.rationale: EQE decreases steadily from the Zn-rich end: 0.54% at Sb 0.2175 (idx 0), 0.30% at 0.237, 0.045% at 0.41, 0.092% at 0.663, 0.040% at 0.856. Index 0 sits at the Zn7Sb2O12 spinel composition (Sb 0.222), whose band gap is near the 3.2 eV illumination. It has the highest EQE of the five measured compositions.
